name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_swap
title: Price a InterestRateSwap
description:
Price one Interest Rate Swap product (qlrisk InterestRateSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, fixed_rate_pct*, floating_index=SOFR, pay_fixed=true, fixed_frequency=semi-annual, float_frequency=quarterly, spread_bp=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, fixed_day_count, float_day_count, amortization_schedule.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4} gives NPV -22,834.98 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
